{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-GHA-CACHE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "Added a narrow actions/cache@v4 step for npm dependency downloads, keyed by runner OS and package-lock.json hash, with cache path ~/.npm and no broad restore fallback. Preserved all original steps, including npm ci and npm test, so required checks remain intact.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]

env:
  YARN_GPG: no

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: ["ubuntu-latest", "macos-latest", "windows-latest"]
        node: ["22", "24", "26"]
    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node }} on ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # 7.0.1
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # 7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm test"
}
